question: Should maintainers accept this member-authored Telegram refactor after confirming that the shared Plugin SDK helper is the canonical behavior for probe failures?
rationale: The patch is intentionally small and reports passing focused validation, but the protected maintainer context requires an explicit human acceptance rather than an automated close or repair action.

options.title: Accept the shared helper
options.body: Merge after confirming the shared SDK helper preserves the prior Telegram probe semantics for strings, Error instances, and object-like thrown values.

options.title: Keep the local helper
options.body: Decline the refactor if Telegram probes intentionally require behavior that differs from the published SDK error-normalization contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared helper
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the shared SDK helper preserves the prior Telegram probe semantics for strings, Error instances, and object-like thrown values.
